events.name: Bash
events.head: Gather T-229 commits, related task state and admin key helpers
events.input: $ git log --oneline -8 --grep='T-229' | cat; echo ---; git log --oneline -5 -- cloud/src | cat; echo ---; python3 - <<'E'

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read how the daily job and probe authenticate to the admin
events.input: $ sed -n 1,60p workshop-plan/ops/zoom_support_check.mjs | cut -c1-220; echo ---; sed -n 1,45p app/scripts/probe-zoom-pro.mjs | cut -c1-240

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find the production admin key file name and the admin API routes
events.input: $ grep -n -E 'admin/enter|secret\("|async function (admin|centre)|admin\(' workshop-plan/ops/zoom_support_check.mjs | cut -c1-220 | head -20; ls ~/.config/tantra/ | head -20; grep -n -E '"(zoom|calendar|attendees)[^"]*"|zoom/(check|attendance|settings|pull)' cloud/src/index.ts | cut -c1-200 | head -30

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read the zoom, attendees and calendar admin route handlers
events.input: $ sed -n 887,960p cloud/src/index.ts | cut -c1-260; sed -n 570,580p cloud/src/index.ts | cut -c1-260; sed -n 762,775p cloud/src/index.ts | cut -c1-200

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read production admin read-only: attendees, zoom overview, calendar, meeting checks

events.text: Live production read is done (all 24 attendees are test, meeting 88135386601 checks clean, Zoom failed 0). Now confirming the deployed Worker version and running the Zoom probe on both stacks.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check deployed Worker version, unpushed cloud commits, and how probes start local stacks
events.input: $ (cd cloud && npx wrangler deployments list 2>&1 | tail -14 | cut -c1-160); echo ---; git log -1 --format='%h %ad %s' --date=iso -- cloud/src | cut -c1-140; git status --short cloud/src | head; git log origin/main -1 --format='origin %h' ; git rev-list --count origin/main..HEAD -- cloud/src; echo ---; grep -n -i -E 'probe-zoom-pro|8896|8897|vendor-sim|wrangler dev' app/scripts/run-chain.sh | cut -c1-220 | head -20; lsof -nP -iTCP -sTCP:LISTEN 2>/dev/null | grep -E ':(88|89)[0-9]{2} ' | awk '{print $1,$9}' | sort -u | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read the local stack start-up part of the chain script

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find the shared local stack ports and simulator wiring
events.input: $ lsof -nP -iTCP -sTCP:LISTEN 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1,$9}' | grep -E ':(8[0-9]{3})$' | sort -u | head -12; sed 's/=.*/=<v>/' cloud/.dev.vars | tr '\n' ' '; echo; grep -n -E 'SIM|8792' cloud/.dev.vars | sed -E 's/(KEY|SECRET)=.*/\1=<v>/' | head; grep -rn -E 'probe-zoom-pro' --include=*.md --include=*.sh --include=*.json -l . 2>/dev/null | grep -v node_modules | head -5; grep -n -E 'SIM_PORT|argv|persist' cloud/scripts/vendor-sim.py | head -8

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find how earlier runs started a fresh local stack for the zoom probe
events.input: $ grep -rn -o -E '.{80}(8896|8897).{120}' workshop-plan/tasks/activity/T-223.json workshop-plan/tasks/activity/T-229.json 2>/dev/null | cut -c1-420 | head -6; grep -rn -E 'SIM_BASE|VENDOR_SIM|ZOOM_BASE|ZOOM_BOT_KEY' cloud/src/*.ts cloud/wrangler.* 2>/dev/null | cut -c1-200 | head -8; launchctl list | grep -i tantra | head; grep -rn -E '889[67]' app/scripts/*.sh workshop-plan/ops/*.sh cloud/scripts/*.sh 2>/dev/null | cut -c1-240 | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read the dev centre and simulator launch agents and the Zoom base wiring
events.input: $ for n in revops-centre-dev revops-sim; do f=~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.tantra.$n.plist; echo "== $n"; [ -f $f ] && plutil -p $f | grep -v -i -E 'key|secret' | cut -c1-260 | head -25; done; grep -n -E 'sim|SIM|zoom\.us|api_base|zoom_base' cloud/src/zoom-pro.ts | head -8 | cut -c1-200; grep -n -i -E 'zoom|bot|sim' app/scripts/probe-zoom-pro.mjs | sed -n 1,400p | grep -i -E 'BOT|settings|PUT' | head -8 | cut -c1-200

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read the dev run script and list listening ports
events.input: $ cat cloud/scripts/run-dev.sh 2>/dev/null | cut -c1-240 | head -30; echo ---; lsof -nP -iTCP -sTCP:LISTEN 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1,$2,$9}' | sort -u | head -30; grep -n -E 'ZOOM_API|SIM_URL|sim_base|8792' cloud/src/util.ts cloud/src/calendar.ts cloud/wrangler.toml cloud/wrangler.jsonc 2>/dev/null | head -8 | cut -c1-200
